title: Elder Origins
description: A Fabric fantasy race mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 with unique races, abilities, strengths, weaknesses, custom UI, and multiplayer support.
body:
Elder Origins

Elder Origins is a Fabric fantasy race mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that lets players choose a race with its own unique strengths, weaknesses, playstyle, and active ability.

Each race changes how you survive, fight, move, and explore the world. Some races are better in melee combat, some are stronger with ranged attacks, some dominate the water, and others rely on darkness, mobility, or special mechanics.

✨ Features

- Fantasy race selection system
- Unique strengths and weaknesses for every race
- Active race abilities
- Race profile screen
- Custom keybinds
- Multiplayer-friendly server synchronization
- Custom race portraits and skins
- Admin-controlled race changing
- English and Russian language support

🧬 Available Races

- Assassin - a fast single-target hunter with Shadow Mark, poison, cuts, and bleeding mechanics.
- Elf - a light ranged fighter with stronger arrows and Windstep mobility.
- Dwarf - a tough frontline fighter with Stoneform for defense and survival.
- Orc - an aggressive melee brawler with Rage and strong close-combat pressure.
- Merfolk - a water-focused race with strong underwater movement and Tidal Jet.
- Vampire - a night predator with lifesteal, darkness bonuses, and Bat Form.

⌨️ Controls

The mod adds customizable controls in Minecraft keybind settings:

- Use Race Ability
- Open Race Selection
- Open Race Profile

🧩 Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader 0.17.2+
- Fabric API required

📝 Notes

Elder Origins is still being improved and expanded. Future updates may add more races, new abilities, better balancing, and more content.
